title: The g64 system fixes of the seven questions hold (WordPress and Joomla FULL demo blogs planned as a whole, one brief per published post, each post written from its own brief through the real Apply door and checked against disobedient models; the title and post tests moved to that flow; EmDash labels the model hands back unchanged or half translated asked again and reported) and ship with their releases: Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.12 and Tracy SaaS EmDash 1.4.9 pinned
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/{joomla-blog-plan-g63,wp-blog-plan-g63}.test.mjs (models that give every brief the same About story, echo lorem, cut titles into sentence tails, return filler, and one that never obeys).

expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.

S3: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.
